verdict.rationale: LightSprint says you can create tasks directly from Slack, Linear, or Jira with two-way sync, and that it manages ticket state as agents work. Each board task gets its own sandbox, and background cloud agents can clear the bug backlog, so the core flow of handing an existing ticket to an agent is covered. Missing for 10: in-depth docs of the ticket-to-agent handoff (how assignment is triggered and configured), any mention of GitHub Issues or other trackers, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.
